lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਰੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak prabh karee kirapaa pooraa satigur paaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, God has granted His Grace, and I have found the Perfect True Guru. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil raheeai prabh saadh janaa mil har keeratan suneeai raam ||
lines.translation: Meet with the holy, humble servants of God; meeting with the Lord, listen to the Kirtan of His Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾਮੋਦਰ ਮਾਧੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਨੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: daiaal prabhoo daamodar maadho a(n)t na paaeeai guneeai raam ||
lines.translation: God is the Merciful Master, the Lord of wealth; there is no end to His Virtues.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲ ਦੁਖ ਹਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਦੋਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: daiaal dukh har saran daataa sagal dokh nivaarano ||
lines.translation: The Merciful Lord is the Dispeller of pain, the Giver of Sanctuary, the Eradicator of all evil.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਸੋਗ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਬਿਖੜੇ ਜਪਤ ਨਾਮ ਉਧਾਰਣੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: moh sog vikaar bikhaRe japat naam udhaarano ||
lines.translation: Emotional attachment, sorrow, corruption and pain - chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one is saved from these.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਭ ਰੇਣ ਥੀਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh jee tere prabhoo mere kar kirapaa sabh ren theevaa ||
lines.translation: All beings are Yours, O my God; bless me with Your Mercy, that I may become the dust under the feet of all men.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਇਆ ਕੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak prabh maiaa keejai naam teraa jap jeevaa ||3||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, O God, be kind to me, that I may chant Your Name, and live. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਅਪਣੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: raakh leee prabh bhagat janaa apanee charanee laae raam ||
lines.translation: God saves His humble devotees, attaching them to His feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਅਪਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰਹ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar apanaa prabh simarah eko naam dhiaae raam ||
lines.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, they meditate in remembrance on their God; they meditae on the One Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਿਆਇ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਰੇ ਭਵਜਲ ਰਹੇ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhiaai so prabh tare bhavajal rahe aavan jaanaa ||
lines.translation: Meditating on that God, they cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and their comings and goings cease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲਗਾ ਮੀਠਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sukh kaliaan keeratan prabh lagaa meethaa bhaanaa ||
lines.translation: They enjoy eternal peace and pleasure, singing the Kirtan of God's Praises; His Will seems so sweet to them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਆਸ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh ichh pu(n)nee aas pooree mile satigur pooriaa ||
lines.translation: All my desires are fulfilled, meeting with the Perfect True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸੂਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak prabh aap mele phir naahee dookh visooriaa ||4||3||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, God has blended me with Himself; I shall never suffer pain or sorrow again. ||4||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 chha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, Chhant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal saranaagatee anad ma(n)gal gun gaam ||
lines.translation: In the Sanctuary of His lotus feet, I sing His Glorious Praises in ecstasy and bliss.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਣ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak prabh aaraadheeai bipat nivaaran raam ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, worship God in adoration, the Eradicator of misfortune. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Chhant:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh bipat nivaarano tis bin avar na koi jeeu ||
lines.translation: God is the Eradicator of misfortune; there is none other than Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sadaa har simareeai jal thal maheeal soi jeeu ||
lines.translation: Forever and ever, remember the Lord in meditation; He is permeating the water, the land and the sky.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal thal maheeal poor rahiaa ik nimakh manahu na veesarai ||
lines.translation: He is permeating and pervading the water, the land and the sky; do not forget Him from your mind, even for an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਦਿਨ ਸਭਾਗੇ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur charan laage din sabhaage sarab gun jagadeesarai ||
lines.translation: Blessed was that day, when I grasped the Guru's feet; all virtues rest in the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar sev sevak dinas rainee tis bhaavai so hoi jeeu ||
lines.translation: So serve Him day and night, O servant; whatever pleases Him, happens.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਖਹ ਦਾਤੇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bal jaai naanak sukhah daate paragaas man tan hoi jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: Nanak is a sacrifice to the Giver of peace; his mind and body are enlightened. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੁਖੀ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਸੋਚ ॥
lines.transliteration: har simarat man tan sukhee binasee duteeaa soch ||
lines.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the mind and body find peace; the thought of duality is dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਟੇਕ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਕੀ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਸੰਕਟ ਮੋਚ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tek goupaal kee govi(n)d sa(n)kat moch ||1||
lines.translation: Nanak takes the support of the Lord of the World, the Lord of the Universe, the Destroyer of troubles. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Chhant:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਸੰਕਟ ਕਾਟੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਦਇਆਲ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai sa(n)kat kaate naaraain daiaal jeeu ||
lines.translation: The Merciful Lord has eradicated my fears and troubles.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਆਨੰਦ ਗਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gun aana(n)d gaae prabh deenaa naath pratipaal jeeu ||
lines.translation: In ecstasy, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; God is the Cherisher, the Master of the meek.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਅਚੁਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਏਕੋ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pratipaal achut purakh eko tisahi siu ra(n)g laagaa ||
lines.translation: The Cherishing Lord is imperishable, the One and only Primal Lord; I am imbued with His Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਚਰਨ ਮਸਤਕੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar charan masatak mel leene sadaa anadin jaagaa ||
lines.translation: When I placed my hands and forehead upon His Feet, He blended me with Himself; I became awake and aware forever, night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਤਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d grihu thaan tis kaa tan joban dhan maal jeeu ||
lines.translation: My soul, body, household and home belong to Him, along with my body, youth, wealth and property.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sad sadaa bal jaai naanak sarab jeeaa pratipaal jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: Forever and ever, Nanak is a sacrifice to Him, who cherishes and nurtures all beings. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਵਖਿਆਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: rasanaa ucharai har hare gun govi(n)d vakhiaan ||
lines.translation: My tongue chants the Name of the Lord, and chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਕੜੀ ਟੇਕ ਏਕ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਰਖੈ ਨਿਦਾਨ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak pakaRee tek ek paramesar rakhai nidaan ||1||
lines.translation: Nanak has grasped the sheltering support of the One Transcendent Lord, who shall save him in the end. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Chhant:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਖਕੋ ਅੰਚਲਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਲਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: so suaamee prabh rakhako a(n)chal taa kai laag jeeu ||
lines.translation: He is God, our Lord and Master, our Saving Grace. Grab hold of the hem of His robe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਜੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੇਵ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaj saadhoo sa(n)g daiaal dev man kee mat tiaag jeeu ||
lines.translation: Vibrate, and meditate on the Merciful Divine Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; renounce your intellectual mind.
